source_message:
feat(compliance): G-16 Hexagonal Architecture — 4 Port ABCs + 5 Adapters (30/30 tests)

Implements GAP-REGISTER G-16: formalises Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters)
as the architectural foundation for the compliance stack (Sprint 0 design, I-21–I-25).

Ports (ABCs — src/compliance/ports/):
  - PolicyPort     — get_threshold / get_jurisdiction_class / get_forbidden_patterns
  - DecisionPort   — emit_decision (async, returns DecisionEvent)
  - EmergencyPort  — is_stopped / activate / clear / get_status (async)
  - AuditPort      — already existed; now re-exported from ports/__init__.py

Adapters (src/compliance/adapters/):
  - ComplianceConfigPolicyAdapter — production PolicyPort backed by compliance_config.yaml (G-07)
  - InMemoryPolicyAdapter         — test/dev PolicyPort with threshold/jurisdiction overrides
  - BanxeAMLDecisionAdapter       — production DecisionPort → AuditPort (constructor injection)
  - MockDecisionAdapter           — test DecisionPort, captures emissions for assertion
  - InMemoryEmergencyAdapter      — test/dev EmergencyPort, full lifecycle + reset()

Tests: test_ports.py T-01..T-30 — 30 passed (full suite 169/169 green)
- T-01: ports/__init__.py exports all 4 ABCs
- T-02–T-05: ABC instantiation guard
- T-06–T-12: ComplianceConfigPolicyAdapter thresholds/jurisdictions/forbidden
- T-13: I-22 — no write/mutate methods on PolicyPort
- T-14–T-16: InMemoryPolicyAdapter defaults + overrides
- T-17–T-22: BanxeAMLDecisionAdapter + MockDecisionAdapter round-trips
- T-23–T-28: InMemoryEmergencyAdapter lifecycle
- T-29: DecisionPort + AuditPort composition round-trip
- T-30: All 4 ports importable from compliance.ports

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
